cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineering Lead – Vehicle Integration to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Develop and implement strategy for product quality from the customer's perspective. Ensure concept quality, usability and functional quality in our product provides safety and customer satisfaction. Manage quality market research activities, quality studies and benchmarks to determine customer quality requirements. Oversee the definition of quality requirements, quality maturity management and quality validation of functions and systems. Risk minimization through use of appropriate risk assessment tools and verification of the robustness of detection and prevention systems for special characteristics. Support the planning, execution and evaluation of product test drives within quality. Execute quality approvals of functions and systems. Define quality processes and technical standards in cooperation with development, product management and operations to ensure product quality. Develop and provide quality leadership to the technical teams and support daily operations. Support and mentor team members, foster a culture of learning, and facilitate skill development to enhance the capabilities of the Technical Quality team. Collaborate with cross-functional teams from other departments to ensure robust product designs, efficient manufacturing processes and effective problem resolution. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
The role will be expected to have high integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness and strive to exhibit a positive and growth mindset. You will feel comfortable operating in a flexible environment with a collaborative approach to achieving goals! You'll also bring:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (e.g. Industrial / mechanical / vehicle, or related field)
10+ Years of experience in automotive engineering/product quality, with at least 3 years in a leadership role in an OEM / Tier 1
Very good technical understanding and sound knowledge of product/vehicle development and production with focus on Vehicle Integrated Systems
Sound knowledge of quality management with in-depth knowledge of Quality Engineering disciplines and risk management
Proficient in the use of commonly applied quality tools and processes in the automotive industry (e.g. IATF 16949, AIAG, VDA, APQP, PPAP)
Good working knowledge of DVP&Rs, FMEAs and Control Plans
Proven track record of directly or functionally leading / building high-performing teams
Highest level of integrity and the ability to make data-driven decisions
Preferred Requirements
A successful history of delivering new program launches on time while achieving metrics
Very good product assessment skills, problem solving and root cause capabilities
Strong teamwork and communication skills, a high level of assertiveness as well as entrepreneurial thinking and goal- and result-oriented decision-making skills
Ability to make data-driven decisions
Basic knowledge and understanding of legal compliance and product liability requirements

Proficient in commonly applied quality tools and processes in the automotive industry (e.g. IATF 16949, AIAG, VDA, APQP, PPAP)

Proven track record of directly or functionally leading and building high-performing teams
Strong teamwork and communication skills, a high level of assertiveness, and goal- and result-oriented decision-making
Highest level of integrity and ability to make data-driven decisions
Preferred Requirements
Successful history of delivering new program launches on time while achieving metrics
Very good product assessment skills, problem solving, and root cause capabilities
Entrepreneurial thinking and resourcefulness
Basic knowledge and understanding of legal compliance and product liability requirements
Comfortable operating in a flexible, start-up environment with a collaborative approach to achieving goals

cond_0331.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineering Lead to join our team at [Company name masked].
cond_0331.responsibilities:
Develop and implement strategy for product quality from the customer's perspective.
Ensure concept quality, usability, and functional quality in our product provides safety and customer satisfaction.
Manage quality market research activities, quality studies, and benchmarks to determine customer quality requirements.
Oversee the definition of quality requirements, quality maturity management, and quality validation of functions and systems.
Minimize risk through appropriate risk assessment tools and verification of detection and prevention systems for special characteristics.
Support the planning, execution, and evaluation of product test drives within quality.
Execute quality approvals of functions and systems.
Define quality processes and technical standards in coordination with development, product management, and operations to ensure product quality.
Provide quality leadership to technical teams and support daily operations.
Support and mentor team members and facilitate skill development to build the capabilities of the Technical Quality team.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams on product design robustness, manufacturing processes, and problem resolution.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (e.g. Industrial, mechanical, vehicle) or related field
10+ Years of experience in automotive engineering or product quality, with at least 3 years in a leadership role at an OEM or Tier 1
Strong technical understanding of product and vehicle development and production, with focus on Vehicle Integrated Systems
Sound knowledge of quality management, Quality Engineering disciplines, and risk management
Proficient in commonly applied quality tools and processes in the automotive industry (e.g. IATF 16949, AIAG, VDA, APQP, PPAP)
Good working knowledge of DVP&Rs, FMEAs, and Control Plans
Proven track record of directly or functionally leading and building high-performing teams
High level of integrity and ability to make data-driven decisions
Preferred Requirements:
Demonstrated history of delivering new program launches on time while achieving metrics
Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis capabilities
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting, with a high level of assertiveness and goal-oriented decision-making
Entrepreneurial thinking and result-oriented approach
Basic knowledge of legal compliance and product liability requirements
Ability to work effectively in a structured, execution-focused start-up environment

cond_0372.intro: [Company name masked] is looking for a Quality Engineering Lead to join our growing team. This position will be responsible for Vehicle Integration, where effective engagement with the development team to deliver the highest quality levels with respect to product and process. The role must work closely with all internal and external partners to exceed customers' expectations.
cond_0372.responsibilities: Develop strategy and implement strategy for product quality from the customer's perspective. Ensure the concept quality, usability and functional quality in our product provides safety and customer satisfaction. Manage the quality market research activities, quality studies and benchmarks to determine customer quality requirements. Oversee the definition of quality requirements, the quality maturity management and quality validation of functions and systems. Risk minimization through use of appropriate risk assessment tools and verification of the robustness of detection and prevention systems for special characteristics. Support the planning, execution and evaluation of product test drives within quality. Execute quality approvals of functions and systems. Definition of quality processes and technical standards in cooperation with development, product management and operations to ensure product quality. Develop and provide quality leadership to the technical teams and drive/support daily operations. Support and mentor team members, foster a culture of learning, and facilitate skill development to enhance the capabilities of the Technical Quality team. Collaborate with cross-functional teams from other departments to ensure robust product designs, efficient manufacturing processes and effective problem resolution. Perform other duties as assigned.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (e.g. Industrial/mechanical/vehicle) or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 10 years of experience in automotive engineering/product quality, with around 3 years in a leadership role in an OEM/Tier 1, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of product/vehicle development and production with a focus on Vehicle Integrated Systems.
A background in delivering new program launches on time while achieving metrics.
Experience with product assessment, problem solving, and root cause analysis.
Background in quality management and familiarity with Quality Engineering disciplines and risk management.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively; openness to entrepreneurial thinking and goal-oriented decision-making.
Experience directly or functionally leading or building teams.
Familiarity with commonly applied quality tools and processes in the automotive industry (e.g. IATF 16949, AIAG, VDA, APQP, PPAP).
Working knowledge of DVP&Rs, FMEAs, and Control Plans.
Ability to make data-driven decisions.
Some exposure to legal compliance and product liability requirements.
High level of integrity.

cond_0510.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineering Lead – Vehicle Integration to join our growing team. This position is responsible for Vehicle Integration, with regular engagement with the development team to deliver the highest quality levels with respect to product and process. The role works closely with all internal and external partners to meet and exceed customers' expectations.
cond_0510.responsibilities: Develop and implement strategy for product quality from the customer's perspective. Ensure the concept quality, usability and functional quality in our product provides safety and customer satisfaction. Stay in regular contact with stakeholders to manage quality market research activities, quality studies and benchmarks to determine customer quality requirements. Oversee the definition of quality requirements, the quality maturity management and quality validation of functions and systems. Minimise risk through use of appropriate risk assessment tools and verification of the robustness of detection and prevention systems for special characteristics. Support the planning, execution and evaluation of product test drives within quality. Execute quality approvals of functions and systems. Define quality processes and technical standards in close cooperation with development, product management and operations to ensure product quality. Develop and provide quality leadership to the technical teams and actively support daily operations. Support and mentor team members, foster a culture of learning, and facilitate skill development to enhance the capabilities of the Technical Quality team. Collaborate daily with cross-functional teams from other departments to clarify requirements, ensure robust product designs, efficient manufacturing processes and effective problem resolution. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0510.requirements:
The role will be expected to have high integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness and a positive and growth mindset. You'll also bring:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (e.g. Industrial / mechanical / vehicle) or related field
10+ Years of experience in automotive engineering / product quality, with at least 3 years in a leadership role in an OEM / Tier 1
Very good technical understanding and sound knowledge of product / vehicle development and production with focus on Vehicle Integrated Systems
Sound knowledge of quality management with in-depth knowledge of Quality Engineering disciplines and risk management
Proven track record of directly or functionally leading / building high-performing teams
Strong teamwork and communication skills, a high level of assertiveness as well as entrepreneurial thinking and goal- and result-oriented decision-making
Highest level of integrity and the ability to make data-driven decisions
Preferred Requirements
A successful history of delivering new program launches on time while achieving metrics
Very good product assessment skills, problem solving and root cause capabilities
Proficient in the use of commonly applied quality tools and processes in the automotive industry (e.g. IATF 16949, AIAG, VDA, APQP, PPAP)
Good working knowledge of DVP&Rs, FMEAs and Control Plans
Basic knowledge and understanding of legal compliance and product liability requirements

Deep knowledge of quality management, with mastery of Quality Engineering disciplines and risk management.

This position focuses on Vehicle Integration, working closely with the development team and all internal and external partners to deliver the highest quality levels in product and process, and to meet customer expectations.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement strategy for product quality from the customer's perspective.
Help ensure concept quality, usability, and functional quality in our product provides safety and customer satisfaction.
Work alongside the team to manage quality market research activities, quality studies, and benchmarks to clarify customer quality requirements.
Support the definition of quality requirements, quality maturity management, and quality validation of functions and systems.
Collaborate on risk minimization through appropriate risk assessment tools and verification of the robustness of detection and prevention systems for special characteristics.
Support the planning, execution, and evaluation of product test drives within quality.
Work with the team to execute quality approvals of functions and systems.
Coordinate with development, product management, and operations to define quality processes and technical standards that ensure product quality.
Share quality leadership with technical teams and support daily operations together.
Support and mentor team members, foster a culture of learning, and facilitate skill development to enhance the capabilities of the Technical Quality team.
Work alongside cross-functional teams from other departments to ensure robust product designs, efficient manufacturing processes, and effective problem resolution.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0648.requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (e.g. Industrial/mechanical/vehicle) or related field
10+ Years of experience in automotive engineering/product quality, with at least 3 years in a leadership role in an OEM/Tier 1
Very good technical understanding and sound knowledge of product/vehicle development and production with focus on Vehicle Integrated Systems
A successful history of delivering new program launches on time while achieving metrics
Very good product assessment skills, problem solving and root cause capabilities
Sound knowledge of quality management with in-depth knowledge of Quality Engineering disciplines and risk management
Strong teamwork and communication skills, a high level of assertiveness as well as entrepreneurial thinking and goal- and result-oriented decision-making skills
Proven track record of directly or functionally leading/building high-performing teams
Proficient in the use of commonly applied quality tools and processes in the automotive industry (e.g. IATF 16949, AIAG, VDA, APQP, PPAP)
Good working knowledge of DVP&Rs, FMEAs, and Control Plans
Ability to make data-driven decisions
Basic knowledge and understanding of legal compliance and product liability requirements
Highest level of integrity and the ability to make data-driven decisions
